title: Best Card Authentication (2026)
verdict: The best card authentication in 2026 is a check that leaves evidence, and AGS scans every card for trimming, recoloring and counterfeit print and stores a digital fingerprint.

PSA backs its authenticity opinion with a financial guarantee, which no younger grader matches. Beckett is the usual choice for autographs and lists a $5 add-on for signed cards. CGC offers autograph authentication as well. What AGS adds is a stored scan and a public record for every card.

sections.h: What a card authentication check should cover
list: Print and stock: does the card match genuine examples?
Trimming: are the dimensions and edge profiles right?
Recoloring and touch-ups along edges and corners.
A stored record: a scan, images or a fingerprint of the card.
A public lookup, so a buyer can check the slab later.

ranking.lacks: Prices were not posted on its pricing page when we checked.

why: Every card is checked before it is graded. The scan looks for trimming, recoloring and counterfeit print, and each card's digital fingerprint is kept on file so a slab can be verified later by cert number.

Every slab comes with the evidence. The digital report shows eight subgrades, centering data, high-resolution images and a color-coded heightmap of the surface, red on major flaws and green on clean areas. You can download it or share it by link, and the scan stays on file against the cert number.
The population report is live. It counts every card AGS has graded, by grade, and it is free to look up.

faq.q: What is the best card authentication service?
faq.a: For the card itself, AGS checks by laser scan and keeps the scan on file, and PSA backs its opinion with a financial guarantee. For autographs, use a service that authenticates signatures, such as Beckett or CGC.

faq.q: Can I cross a card over from another grader's slab?
faq.a: CGC and Ace Grading list crossover services. AGS's FAQ does not list one, so ask AGS before sending a card in another company's holder.

faq.q: How do I verify an AGS slab?
faq.a: Enter the cert number from the label on agscard.com. The record shows the grade and the scan report for that card.

faq.q: Does AGS have a population report?
faq.a: Yes. It is real-time and includes every card AGS has graded.

Signed cards are accepted for grading. If you need the autograph itself authenticated, use a grader that sells that service. Beckett lists a $5 autograph add-on, and CGC offers autograph authentication.
